summary: Docs-only, one file, +25/-2: a seven-day categorized Webull entry census appended to the 09-09 investigation note. Ancestor property checked with the gate's own test before anything else. EVERY LOAD-BEARING NUMBER RE-DERIVED FROM THE PRODUCTION DB, not accepted from the PR. Arithmetic is internally consistent: 34 filled + 32 blocked/rejected + 6 accepted-unfilled = 72, and the blocked subtotal 21+7+3+1 = 32. Webull (live:orb) ENTRY fills for 2026-09-03..09-09, using side=buy AND client_order_id NOT LIKE '%-ocoexit-%' to avoid the entry-vs-exit trap, = EXACTLY 34, and the symbol list reproduces character for character: AEHL, BNC, CDTG, CHPT, FTFT, GELS, IMRN, MOBX, NUR, SUNE, YMAT. THE HEADLINE CLAIM SURVIVED THE CONTAMINATION CHECK THAT MATTERS: the doc says Webull minimum-order-size on MIMI is the ONLY actual venue-rejection category, yet broker_orders shows 58 rejected rows across 10 symbols in that window, and broker_order_events reports event_source='broker' for all of them - so a naive read contradicts the doc. Splitting by client_order_id resolves it: MIMI x13 are the ONLY '-open-' (ENTRY) rejections; the other 45 are ALL '-close-' EXIT rejections (FTFT 15, AEHL 14, YMAT 4, CHPT 3, SUNE 3, CDTG 3, MOBX 1, BNC 1, NUR 1) and are correctly outside an ENTRY census. The doc's claim is exact. ⚠ OUT OF SCOPE BUT RECORDED FOR THE BOARD, NOT BLOCKING THIS PR: those 45 rejected Webull EXIT orders across four sessions are a live-money signal in their own right - a rejected exit is a protection attempt that did not land - and belong on the board as their own row rather than being absorbed into an entry census. No strategy, OMS, configuration, migration or runtime change; the doc explicitly scopes the wider-window table as superseding the three-symbol counts only for the category question and leaves the FTFT/SUNE/YMAT incident evidence as the source, which matches what I verified yesterday at head fd788f69 and 2bd2355c.
